svg.text: rx_lsq: the Q tap level shifter (a copy of lsdiv's, with the same load)
ls_ac (the 2 fF metal-finger Cc level shifter) drives a dummy tspc_t1 and a dummy TX tap inverter TT, as lsdiv's ls does: its delay (about 120 deg at 434 MHz) then matches the I tap's
header Hq (qenb low = on) feeds vq; Dq holds lsq low when off; the layout must copy lsdiv's LS cell; source: sim/rx/rx_lo.py lsq()
